text: I’m a third-generation resident of Orange. I was a Captain in the United States Army, serving our country on three combat deployments in the Middle East and East Africa. I graduated from Orange Unified School District schools, the United States Military Academy at West Point, and the University of Southern California.
Today, I continue my service here in my hometown of Orange as Chair of the Santiago Creek Commission and a Member of the Orange County Transportation Authority Citizens Advisory Committee.

If you elect me to represent our community on the Orange City Council, I will:
Strengthen funding for Orange firefighters and police Grow Orange’s economy by attracting new businesses and retaining existing businesses
Ensuring complete accountability with our taxpayer dollars Improve efficiency and reduce waste
Protect the character of our neighborhoods and Orange's quality of life
Preserve our open space and local waterways
I’m not a politician. Orange and the Army gave me my values and work ethic, which I’ll bring to the City Council.

I have earned the endorsements of our City of Orange leaders for
City Council:
Orange City Firefighters
Mayor Dan Slater
Former Mayor Carolyn Cavecche
Our retiring District 6 Councilmember John Gyllenhammer
Majority of the Orange City Council
I would be honored to have your vote. moellerfororange.com
